This update is notable for reworking the [[Gladiator]]. This update encompassed four versions: the main v2.7.0 update (released 21 August 2026) and three minor updates, v2.7.1 (released 21 August 2026), v2.7.2 (released 21 August 2026) and v2.7.3 (released 28 August 2026). ==Additions== ===Stickers=== *[[Triumph]] ==Changes & Bugfixes== ===Towers=== *[[Gladiator]] reworked. **''Warrior's Call'' replaced with ''War Cry''. ***Now removes [[Fatigue Debuff]] and [[Scared Debuff]] from the '''Gladiator''' when used. **''Fire Aspect'' added, which once its cooldown is over causes the next hit to inflict burn on enemies. **Placement limit removed. **'''Gladiator''' is available through a gamepass for {{Robux|599}}. **Statistical changes: ***'''Level 1''' ****Cost decreased from {{Money|450}} to {{Money|375}}. ****Swingrate changed from ****Name changed from ''Dangersense'' to ''Warrior's Call''. ***'''Level 3''' ****Cost increased from {{Money|2,000}} to {{Money|2,125}}. ****Damage decreased from +20 to +10. ****Swingrate changed
